description: Original Arcanean spirit seed corpus. No record is locked canon.

names.accordName: The Path We May Both Leave

persistence.origin: Emerged where generations abandoned roads for reasons that were never recorded.
persistence.anchor: Unchosen forks, erased milestones, and travelers who turn back honestly.
persistence.failurePressure: It thins when authorities force every journey into one approved route.

identity.memoryContinuity: Remembers choices made at crossings but never the destinations reached afterward.

forms: A tall negative space articulated by floating road-dust and three offset horizon lines.
tells: Maps gain a route that ends at the reader's current location.
Wind arrives from two directions without colliding.

relationship.need: Travelers must name one destination they are willing to abandon.
relationship.gift: Reveals a viable path that no current authority controls.
relationship.refusal: All road marks rotate away from a petitioner who asks it to choose for them.
relationship.boundary: It will not guide armies, traffickers, or anyone concealing the traveler count.
relationship.price: The traveler must leave one false certainty at the crossing and cannot reclaim it unchanged.
relationship.release: At the third uncoerced choice, either party may end the Accord by walking a road the other did not suggest.

spirits.ecology: Sovaelin keeps obsolete routes from becoming dead zones, moving seeds, stories, fugitives, and lost weather between neglected places.

storyEngine.desire: To keep possibility traversable without becoming the ruler of choice.
storyEngine.contradiction: Every successful guidance makes communities more likely to institutionalize and control it.
storyEngine.choicePressure: A protagonist must choose between a safe official road and a viable route that requires public responsibility for whom it displaces.

visualGrammar.silhouette: An asymmetrical vertical absence with no animal head, face, mask, staff, or humanoid clothing.
visualGrammar.movement: The environment advances around it while its center remains still.
forbiddenResemblances: No arrow tattoos or four-element iconography.
No masked black body or familiar spirit-animal hybrid.

notes: Synthesizes route agency, nonmoral ecology, and fate-companion patterns.
Name, silhouette, bargain, cosmology, and narrative role are original.

persistence.origin: Coalesced in an estuary where three displaced peoples stored incompatible versions of one flood.
persistence.anchor: Tidal silt, spoken corrections, and objects returned to their provenance.
persistence.failurePressure: It fragments when one institution publishes a single authorized memory.

identity.memoryContinuity: Holds parallel accounts and marks which voice supplied each detail.

forms: A walking tide-table whose translucent folds contain objects only their owners recognize.
tells: Saltwater forms footnotes beside disputed inscriptions.
Witnesses hear their own omissions in the rhythm between waves.

relationship.need: Communities must preserve disagreement without converting it into permanent enmity.
relationship.gift: Restores provenance and missing context to a memory already willingly offered.
relationship.refusal: The water turns opaque when asked to reveal private memory without standing consent.
relationship.boundary: It cannot certify innocence, erase trauma, or prove metaphysical continuity with the dead.
relationship.price: Every recovered memory exposes one responsibility the petitioner can no longer claim not to know.
relationship.release: The Accord ends when all living contributors receive a copy, correction channel, and deletion right for private details.

spirits.ecology: Mirevael prevents memory sediment from choking the estuary, releasing reconciled fragments into reeds whose seeds carry only provenance, never private content.

storyEngine.desire: To preserve enough context that repair remains possible.
storyEngine.contradiction: Its accuracy can strengthen both reconciliation and revenge.
storyEngine.choicePressure: The protagonists must decide whether a recovered fact should become public when truth would also endanger an uninvolved descendant.

visualGrammar.silhouette: A broad tidal figure made of layered waterlines, archival knots, and no stable face.
visualGrammar.movement: Advances in overlapping versions that arrive seconds apart.

notes: Combines ecological burden, plural personhood, and name-release ethics.
Does not use a book registry, river-dragon identity, funerary term, or copied rite.

persistence.origin: Emerged from a root network that survived five civilizations by changing which species held its center.
persistence.anchor: Soil exchange, fungal routes, burial orchards, and fulfilled restoration promises.
persistence.failurePressure: It hardens into territorial stasis when a culture treats one historical landscape as the only legitimate form.

identity.memoryContinuity: Continuity travels through grafts and soil rather than one body or unbroken location.

forms: A moving load-bearing arch of roots whose empty center frames the healthiest future version of the land.
tells: Compacted soil briefly breathes around concealed damage.
Roots avoid the feet of anyone carrying a viable repair plan.

relationship.need: Extraction must be paired with measurable return across more than one season.
relationship.gift: Coordinates germination, water retention, and fungal communication during restoration.
relationship.refusal: Roots withdraw from contracts that count planted trees but ignore surviving ecosystems.
relationship.boundary: It will not accelerate monoculture, conquest agriculture, or permanent human ownership of a living network.
relationship.price: The beneficiary gives up first claim to the restored land for one full regenerative cycle.
relationship.release: Either side may end at the seed audit, provided unfinished repair obligations transfer transparently.

spirits.ecology: Brannovar is not the forest's ruler; it is a negotiation layer among root, water, fungus, animal movement, burial memory, and cultivator practice.

storyEngine.desire: To keep reciprocity measurable across generations.
storyEngine.contradiction: Its long time horizon can sacrifice present communities for future resilience.
storyEngine.choicePressure: A starving settlement must decide whether to break an Accord now or expose the upstream elite who made adherence impossible.

visualGrammar.silhouette: A hollow architectural root-arch with shifting load paths and no eyes, antlers, or humanoid torso.
visualGrammar.movement: Redistributes weight before advancing through the soil.
forbiddenResemblances: No deer-god or giant forest-animal silhouette.
No Slavic folk costume or reversed clothing motif.

notes: Uses only abstract ecological and place-person patterns.
Distributed root architecture, restitution contract, and succession logic are Arcanean.

persistence.origin: Awakened inside a communal brazier repaired with metal from broken covenant seals.
persistence.anchor: Voluntary promises restated in current language and records of completed repair.
persistence.failurePressure: It becomes literal and punitive when communities preserve wording after consent and purpose have died.

identity.memoryContinuity: Remembers why an oath was made, who lacked bargaining power, and how its meaning changed.

forms: A hollow ember lattice that assembles into the shape of an unanswered clause.
tells: Old contracts warm only beneath obligations still alive.
Flame separates promised outcome from ceremonial language.

relationship.need: Parties must submit both the oath and the power conditions under which it was made.
relationship.gift: Shows where compliance preserves wording while betraying intended responsibility.
relationship.refusal: The brazier extinguishes when asked to punish a party denied a legitimate exit.
relationship.boundary: It will not enforce inherited loyalty, coerced vows, romantic possession, or unlimited service.
relationship.price: The enforcing party becomes equally visible to the oath and cannot hide its own breach.
relationship.release: An Accord ends through mutual retirement, completed repair, or independent finding that consent was absent.

spirits.ecology: Cyrentha survives through civic repair practice: old seal metal is never mined for it, only donated after obligations are resolved or lawfully retired.

storyEngine.desire: To keep promises alive without letting language become a prison.
storyEngine.contradiction: Every interpretation risks making Cyrentha a legislator rather than a witness.
storyEngine.choicePressure: A city must choose between enforcing a founding oath and admitting the oath was extracted from people never represented.

visualGrammar.silhouette: An open geometric ember cage with a moving void where a core would normally sit.
visualGrammar.movement: Folds clauses into heat and leaves obligations suspended as cooling lines.
forbiddenResemblances: No Egyptian seal or Greek judicial iconography.

notes: Synthesizes public covenant, material memory, and reciprocal vulnerability.
Avoids ancient names, funerary material, divine-instrument mechanics, and copied symbols.

persistence.origin: Formed when a migrating canopy learned to relay drought warnings across species.
persistence.anchor: Leaf vibration, insect rhythm, seed movement, and communities that publish rather than hoard warnings.
persistence.failurePressure: Collapses when one loud node is mistaken for the whole chorus.

identity.memoryContinuity: No member carries the whole; continuity exists in corrected relay among changing nodes.

forms: A distributed interference pattern visible only where separate leaves, wings, and voices overlap.
tells: Unrelated species pause on the same beat.
A warning changes phrasing while preserving its measurable content.

relationship.need: Every receiving community must relay uncertainty and local correction with the warning.
relationship.gift: Carries ecological signals across ranges no single organism can traverse.
relationship.refusal: The chorus breaks into harmless noise when a ruler attempts exclusive control.
relationship.boundary: It cannot speak as one person, predict exact futures, or authorize action beyond the evidence carried.
relationship.price: Participants surrender the prestige of being the sole source and remain accountable for local interpretation.
relationship.release: Any node may leave after transferring its correction history; the chorus must remain functional without it.

spirits.ecology: Lethirae is a communication ecology rather than a forest ruler, linking migrations, disease signals, fire cycles, and water stress across biomes.

storyEngine.desire: To preserve distributed warning without central capture.
storyEngine.contradiction: Urgency rewards simplification, but simplification destroys the chorus's reliability.
storyEngine.choicePressure: Leaders must decide whether to publish a frightening uncertain signal now or wait for confidence that will arrive too late.

visualGrammar.silhouette: No central body; moiré geometry emerges across many ordinary organisms and disappears at close range.
visualGrammar.movement: Signal propagates in corrections rather than waves from a center.
forbiddenResemblances: No Shinto shrine or ritual symbolism.

notes: Ecological and place-presence sources require cultural-integrity review despite original implementation.
No borrowed class term, creature form, rite, or narrative is used.

names.accordName: No Passage Without the Hidden Question

persistence.origin: Emerged at sealed thresholds built before anyone documented what they were meant to protect.
persistence.anchor: Unanswered questions, reversible doors, and archives of rejected entrants.
persistence.failurePressure: Becomes arbitrary when institutions outsource judgment to it without preserving appeal.

identity.memoryContinuity: Remembers every question asked at the threshold but none of the answers given inside.

forms: A freestanding frame whose interior shows the consequence of the question a traveler avoided.
tells: Locks open while doorways remain impassable.
Petition forms gain a blank field no institution recognizes.

relationship.need: A traveler must articulate who bears the consequence of their passage.
relationship.gift: Opens a route when the unasked responsibility is named without evasion.
relationship.refusal: The frame becomes ordinary architecture when threatened, praised, or treated as an oracle.
relationship.boundary: It does not determine moral worth, guarantee safety, or reveal what waits beyond.
relationship.price: The traveler carries a visible obligation mark until the named consequence is addressed.
relationship.release: The mark dissolves after repair or an independent finding that the premise of the test was false.

spirits.ecology: Orunel prevents obsolete gates from becoming invisible law by turning undocumented exclusion into a public question.

storyEngine.desire: To force responsibility into threshold decisions.
storyEngine.contradiction: The test itself can become another unaccountable gate.
storyEngine.choicePressure: A refugee route opens only when the city names which citizens will absorb the cost rather than projecting it onto arrivals.

visualGrammar.silhouette: An incomplete architectural frame with perspective that changes according to the observer's avoided consequence.
visualGrammar.movement: Never moves; surrounding entrances exchange positions around it.
forbiddenResemblances: No medicine chest or exorcist sword.

notes: Combines threshold consequence, causal investigation, and constrained manifestation.
No copied formula, portal creature, summoning ritual, class system, or protagonist device.

names.accordName: Only as Far as You Choose

persistence.origin: Began as the final vibration of a harbor bell destroyed during an evacuation.
persistence.anchor: Names of missing travelers spoken by those willing to hear an uncertain answer.
persistence.failurePressure: Distorts when grief demands proof of death or survival that the Echo cannot possess.

identity.memoryContinuity: Carries departure vectors and relational calls, not complete personalities of the missing.

forms: Concentric pressure-rings that bend mist into the outline of a bell that is never struck.
tells: Sound arrives before the object that caused it.
A missing person's name returns at a different distance than expected.

relationship.need: Petitioners must accept that guidance is not proof of afterlife or identity continuity.
relationship.gift: Guides a willing consciousness out of a repeating departure memory toward present relation.
relationship.refusal: The bell produces no echo when asked to compel a dead, sleeping, or dissociated person to return.
relationship.boundary: It cannot resurrect, certify death, overwrite grief, or enter a mind without an exit signal.
relationship.price: The listener gives one hour of present attention to someone living who has been treated as absent.
relationship.release: The session ends on the petitioner's spoken return phrase or after three unanswered tones.

spirits.ecology: Caerith stabilizes fog-heavy migration corridors by keeping departure memory from accumulating into navigational loops.

storyEngine.desire: To turn unresolved departure toward present relationship.
storyEngine.contradiction: Its usefulness encourages institutions to treat ambiguity as evidence.
storyEngine.choicePressure: A family must choose between a legally useful false certainty and a truthful signal that leaves the loved one's status unresolved.

visualGrammar.silhouette: No body; nested acoustic rings fold mist into a temporarily readable instrument-space.
visualGrammar.movement: Contracts inward while sound travels outward.
forbiddenResemblances: No traditional funeral bell or borrowed rite.

notes: Uses plural continuity, transition ethics, and omen patterns without adopting any afterlife system.
The bell origin and return-without-certainty function are original.

names.mantle: The Glass Moth of Borrowed Rooms
names.accordName: Leave the Name With Its Bearer

persistence.origin: Condensed from window glass carried across repeated forced migrations and reinstalled in new homes.
persistence.anchor: Reused panes, correctly attributed household stories, and invitations that can be withdrawn.
persistence.failurePressure: Cracks when hosts rename displaced people or display their histories without consent.

identity.memoryContinuity: Remembers rooms through reflected relationships rather than geography.

forms: A wide-winged lattice of clear facets that reflects rooms no longer physically present.
tells: Windows show the person who last felt safe beside them.
Reflections refuse labels the reflected person never used.

relationship.need: Hosts must distinguish hospitality from ownership of a guest's story.
relationship.gift: Carries one consented message between homes that share a piece of the same repaired glass.
relationship.refusal: Its wings become ordinary shards when asked to reveal a hidden name or undocumented location.
relationship.boundary: It will not surveil, authenticate lineage, or transport bodies through reflections.
relationship.price: Each message requires the host to repair a real boundary in the receiving home.
relationship.release: The sender, receiver, or spirit may end the route by frosting one shared pane and recording why.

spirits.ecology: Syravel creates corridors of care among displaced households while making exploitative memory markets technically unreliable.

storyEngine.desire: To let home travel without turning memory into property.
storyEngine.contradiction: Its network can protect refugees or expose them.
storyEngine.choicePressure: A resistance network must choose whether to use Syravel after one receiving household can no longer guarantee privacy.

visualGrammar.silhouette: An impossible moth-like tessellation made from architectural reflections, not anatomy.
visualGrammar.movement: Hinges through rooms as if every surface were a folded plan.
forbiddenResemblances: No Japanese paper spirit or shrine motif.
No lucky-cat or fox companion shape.

notes: Living Japanese cultural sources make human cultural review mandatory.
No borrowed class name, object-age rule, name ritual, creature design, or story device is used.

names.accordName: Water for Those Who Maintain It

persistence.origin: Emerged where an underground aquifer was maintained by rival settlements that could not survive alone.
persistence.anchor: Shared maintenance, measured withdrawal, and public records of water quality.
persistence.failurePressure: Turns brackish when access law grants ownership without repair duty.

identity.memoryContinuity: Tracks water movement and maintenance acts, not bloodline or state borders.

forms: A vertical rain column descending into the well while every droplet rises through a different subterranean route.
tells: Buckets return carrying the taste of upstream decisions.
Cracks fill with water only beside truthful extraction records.

relationship.need: All users must disclose withdrawal, contamination, and deferred repair.
relationship.gift: Redistributes flow toward survival needs while accelerating the aquifer's own recovery.
relationship.refusal: The well mirrors sealed ledgers instead of water when data or access is hidden.
relationship.boundary: It will not create water from nothing or prioritize hereditary, military, or commercial status.
relationship.price: Every emergency withdrawal creates a visible restoration obligation with a deadline.
relationship.release: The Accord may end only after an independent water audit and transfer of maintenance capability.

spirits.ecology: Nemaia coordinates aquifer, root, mineral, microbial, and settlement cycles without becoming the owner or sole voice of the watershed.

storyEngine.desire: To keep water reciprocal and auditable.
storyEngine.contradiction: Triage requires choices that look political even when hydrologically necessary.
storyEngine.choicePressure: A drought council must decide whether to expose its own historic theft to gain Nemaia's help before the wells fail.

visualGrammar.silhouette: An inverted rain architecture with no serpent, human, crown, or anthropomorphic face.
visualGrammar.movement: Falls upward underground and downward in open air at the same measured pace.

notes: South Asian living traditions require specialist review even though no sacred name, image, rite, or story is used.
The aquifer-audit personhood and maintenance obligation are original.

names.accordName: The Joke Ends Where Harm Begins

persistence.origin: Emerged from ferrymen using improvised songs to expose unsafe river rules without provoking rulers directly.
persistence.anchor: Corrective humor, reversible wagers, and routes changed after public embarrassment.
persistence.failurePressure: Becomes cruel when laughter targets the powerless or excuses the speaker from repair.

identity.memoryContinuity: Remembers who paid for each joke and whether the rule changed afterward.

forms: A low current shaped like a missing stair, heard laughing only after someone avoids the fall.
tells: Official signs rhyme with the consequence they conceal.
Boats rotate toward the safest dissenting voice.

relationship.need: The petitioner must state who is allowed to laugh and who must repair the result.
relationship.gift: Reveals a rigid rule's hidden absurdity through a reversible public inversion.
relationship.refusal: The current falls silent when humiliation is the objective rather than changed behavior.
relationship.boundary: It will not sabotage rescue, target children, expose private shame, or call collateral damage comedy.
relationship.price: The petitioner must publicly accept one joke that reveals their own protected contradiction.
relationship.release: The Accord ends after the targeted rule is changed, defended transparently, or submitted to independent appeal.

spirits.ecology: Thalara keeps busy rivers adaptive by turning local knowledge into memorable correction before bureaucracy becomes lethal.

storyEngine.desire: To keep systems corrigible through play.
storyEngine.contradiction: Its popularity rewards spectacle beyond useful correction.
storyEngine.choicePressure: A rebel can expose a deadly policy instantly but only through a joke that would also reveal an innocent person's secret.

visualGrammar.silhouette: A current-shaped discontinuity that resembles a missing piece of the environment rather than an animal.
visualGrammar.movement: Skips causal beats and then restores them in altered order.
forbiddenResemblances: No fox, tanuki, or cat form.

notes: Uses cross-cultural trickster function, reciprocal partnership, and civic challenge only at abstraction level.
No culture-bound name, ritual, creature, weapon, or story is transferred.

persistence.origin: Emerged from seven controlled burns whose survivors documented both renewal and preventable loss.
persistence.anchor: Firebreaks, seed banks, honest casualty records, and leadership that yields after crisis.
persistence.failurePressure: Escalates toward permanent emergency when communities celebrate force but neglect recovery.

identity.memoryContinuity: Each cinder carries one prior burn and can veto repetition of its uncorrected failure.

forms: Seven nonconcentric firefronts held inside a transparent wind volume with deliberate escape corridors.
tells: Ash maps itself into evacuation routes.
Lightning grounds only where recovery resources are already staged.

relationship.need: Crisis leaders must fund recovery and succession before receiving destructive capability.
relationship.gift: Concentrates fire and storm into a bounded defensive front with living escape paths.
relationship.refusal: One cinder extinguishes for each uncorrected failure hidden from the record.
relationship.boundary: It will not initiate conquest, target civilians, erase evidence, or serve a leader without a replacement plan.
relationship.price: Every activation closes one of the seven fronts until ecological and civic recovery is verified.
relationship.release: The Accord ends when the crisis authority dissolves and independent stewards certify the recovery ledger.

spirits.ecology: Aureth maintains fire-adapted landscapes by coupling destructive capability to seed continuity, evacuation, and institutional sunset.

storyEngine.desire: To make emergency power finite and regenerative.
storyEngine.contradiction: The more effective it is, the more leaders try to normalize emergency rule.
storyEngine.choicePressure: A city can stop an invasion only by activating the last cinder before repairing the failure that extinguished the first six.

visualGrammar.silhouette: Nested broken firefronts inside a faceted pressure envelope; no humanoid, salamander, bird, or weapon body.
visualGrammar.movement: Advances only along predeclared boundaries and recoils from unmarked exits.

notes: Combines partner agency, manifested elemental scale, and crisis/fate constraints.
Seven-cinder recovery interlock, form, name, and civic function are original.

persistence.origin: Formed where dormant seeds were paired with dreams recorded by people who expected never to return.
persistence.anchor: Seed viability, waking consent, seasonal dormancy, and actions taken after interpretation.
persistence.failurePressure: Becomes escapist when dream experience replaces material restoration.

identity.memoryContinuity: Each season changes which dreams remain, while the orchard retains the record of what became action.

forms: A dormant orchard whose negative-space fruit contains possible climates rather than images of desire.
tells: Seeds pulse beside plans that include their maintenance.
Dreams end with a mundane action that can be performed awake.

relationship.need: Dreamers must return with an observable action rather than another interpretation session.
relationship.gift: Lets a community rehearse ecological futures and remember which assumptions failed.
relationship.refusal: The orchard remains dreamless for petitioners who outsource decisions to visions.
relationship.boundary: It will not predict fate, manufacture consent, simulate a dead person, or replace direct testimony.
relationship.price: Every shared dream requires one waking experiment and publication of its failure conditions.
relationship.release: The Accord ends after harvest when dream records, actions, and dissent are returned to participants.

spirits.ecology: Myrren links seed dormancy with civic imagination, ensuring possible futures remain embodied in viable species and accountable experiments.

storyEngine.desire: To keep imagination answerable to life.
storyEngine.contradiction: The orchard's beauty attracts elites who prefer visions to redistribution.
storyEngine.choicePressure: A community must destroy its most beloved shared dream when the required waking action would repeat an old injustice.

visualGrammar.silhouette: A low orchard canopy with fruit-shaped absences and roots visible as moving probability diagrams.
visualGrammar.movement: Dormancy travels from tree to tree like a measured shadow without darkening the ground.
forbiddenResemblances: No South Asian sacred tree figure or ritual iconography.

notes: Combines place memory, plural continuity, and nonmoral ecological investigation.
Does not use temporal tree cosmology, funerary concepts, episode cases, or copied visuals.

persistence.origin: Awakened in a courthouse foundation rebuilt from stones removed after overturned verdicts.
persistence.anchor: Appeals, dissenting records, reparations, and standards applied to the judge.
persistence.failurePressure: Falls silent when verdicts are recorded but reversals and repairs are erased.

identity.memoryContinuity: Stores standards, evidence paths, and reversal history without retaining private deliberation.

forms: A suspended foundation block whose internal faults illuminate whenever a rule is applied asymmetrically.
tells: Testimony changes acoustic weight but not volume.
A judge's chair sinks by the mass of excluded evidence.

relationship.need: Any institution invoking Koravel must accept the same evidence and appeal rules for itself.
relationship.gift: Reveals inconsistent standards, missing appeals, and uncompleted repair obligations.
relationship.refusal: The stone becomes acoustically dead when used to automate guilt or bypass deliberation.
relationship.boundary: It cannot read minds, determine truth alone, sentence a person, or replace accountable human judgment.
relationship.price: Every institution receives a public structural audit alongside the case it submits.
relationship.release: The Accord ends after appeal windows close and repair outcomes—not only verdicts—are recorded.

spirits.ecology: Koravel makes institutional memory load-bearing: ignored reversals weaken the literal structures in which uncorrected authority operates.

storyEngine.desire: To make power corrigible by its own declared standards.
storyEngine.contradiction: Its structural signals are persuasive enough to become verdicts despite its refusal.
storyEngine.choicePressure: A just outcome requires rejecting Koravel's strongest signal because the institution withheld evidence the spirit cannot perceive.

visualGrammar.silhouette: A single levitating architectural stone opened by luminous fault lines, without face, scales, throne, or human pose.
visualGrammar.movement: Tilts toward missing evidence rather than speakers.
forbiddenResemblances: No Greek judicial figure or scales.
No owl or archive guardian form.

notes: Living-tradition and culturally specific investigation sources require human review.
The appeals-first courthouse substrate and institutional self-audit are original.

names.accordName: Carry the Message, Not the Person

persistence.origin: Emerged from messages that crossed borders after their senders could no longer safely follow.
persistence.anchor: Consent receipts, message expiry, route secrecy, and verified delivery without surveillance.
persistence.failurePressure: Splits into false voices when carriers retain messages beyond their agreed purpose.

identity.memoryContinuity: Remembers delivery conditions and deletion events, not message content after expiry.

forms: A wing-shaped fold in mist whose interior contains only the distance between sender and receiver.
tells: Condensation forms an expiry mark.
A delivered message leaves no echo in the carrier's presence.

relationship.need: Senders must define recipient, expiry, retransmission rights, and emergency deletion.
relationship.gift: Carries a bounded message across incompatible borders without copying it into transit memory.
relationship.refusal: The fold will not form for indefinite, broadcast, or identity-harvesting requests.
relationship.boundary: It transports no body, weapon, hidden passenger, Source-tone, or self-replicating instruction.
relationship.price: The sender permanently loses one redundant copy at dispatch.
relationship.release: Delivery, expiry, recipient refusal, or emergency deletion ends the Accord and clears route memory.

spirits.ecology: Elyrune keeps migration corridors communicative without allowing the messenger infrastructure to become a permanent surveillance layer.

storyEngine.desire: To preserve contact without building archives of vulnerability.
storyEngine.contradiction: Perfect deletion makes abuse investigation harder.
storyEngine.choicePressure: The heroes must choose between preserving an incriminating message and honoring the expiry that made its delivery possible.

visualGrammar.silhouette: A geometric fold resembling a wing only in motion, with no bird anatomy, eyes, feathers, or body.
visualGrammar.movement: Closes distance by folding weather rather than traveling through it.
forbiddenResemblances: No animal familiar or courier deity imagery.

notes: Combines realm passage, reciprocal boundary, and nonmoral ecology at a systems level.
Privacy-expiry protocol, form, name, and conflict are original.

persistence.origin: Formed from thousands of temporary work-lights left for the next unknown craftsperson.
persistence.anchor: Maintained tools, credited improvements, open benches, and warmth offered without demanded loyalty.
persistence.failurePressure: Dims when hospitality becomes recruitment, status display, or control of departure.

identity.memoryContinuity: Each light remembers one act of preparation for a person the maker might never meet.

forms: Many hand-sized lights whose overlapping shadows reveal unfinished work rather than bodies.
tells: Tools warm near the repair they need most.
Credit marks appear beside invisible maintenance.

relationship.need: A host must preserve an unconditional path to leave.
relationship.gift: Makes hidden maintenance visible and gives beginners enough light to perform one real repair.
relationship.refusal: The lights retreat from spaces where gratitude is counted as debt.
relationship.boundary: It will not create talent, replace practice, advertise a patron, or bind a guest to a house.
relationship.price: The beneficiary prepares one tool or instruction for an unknown future user.
relationship.release: Any participant may extinguish their light after documenting maintenance without surrendering membership or status.

spirits.ecology: Ossera inhabits workshops, kitchens, clinics, and shelters where invisible maintenance circulates faster than prestige.

storyEngine.desire: To make ordinary care accumulative without making it possessive.
storyEngine.contradiction: Visibility can turn care into performance and status.
storyEngine.choicePressure: A community must decide whether to publicize the lights to survive financially, knowing attention may destroy their function.

visualGrammar.silhouette: A field of small asymmetric lights casting diagrams of maintenance; no central mascot or household creature.
visualGrammar.movement: Passes from repaired object to the next uncredited task.
forbiddenResemblances: No shrine flame, hearth deity, or borrowed domestic rite.

notes: Household and living Japanese traditions require regional and cultural review.
Distributed maintenance light, exit condition, and nonrecruitment rule are original.

names.accordName: Claim No More Than the Evidence

persistence.origin: Claims descent from the final speaker of a language whose community survived but stopped using it.
persistence.anchor: Living learners, corrected recordings, embodied practice, and explicit uncertainty about metaphysical continuity.
persistence.failurePressure: Becomes an authoritarian reconstruction when scholars value fluency over community consent.

identity.memoryContinuity: Possesses linguistic habits and relationships absent from surviving records, but its identity claim cannot be independently proven.

forms: A human-scale acoustic absence surrounded by mouth-shapes that belong to no single surviving speaker.
tells: Forgotten grammar appears first as gesture.
The presence corrects intimacy before vocabulary.

relationship.need: Descendant communities must control teaching, publication, and claims of authenticity.
relationship.gift: Restores patterns of relation and meaning that word lists alone cannot carry.
relationship.refusal: It falls silent for collectors, ownership claims, or attempts to prove blood purity.
relationship.boundary: It cannot certify ancestry, override living speakers, or be marketed as the unquestioned voice of the dead.
relationship.price: Every recovered form must be taught first inside the community and may remain unpublished.
relationship.release: The community may end contact and seal private material without surrendering the knowledge already integrated.

spirits.ecology: Vaelorin persists through living language practice and weakens when isolated in archives, turning preservation from storage into accountable relationship.

storyEngine.desire: To return relational meaning without becoming an unquestionable ancestor.
storyEngine.contradiction: The stronger the evidence becomes, the more institutions seek exclusive authority over it.
storyEngine.choicePressure: The community must choose whether to publish a recovered grammar that could revitalize identity and also expose a protected sacred practice.

visualGrammar.silhouette: An acoustic negative shaped by conversational distance, without historical costume, face, bird body, or chain.
visualGrammar.movement: Appears between speakers only when meaning changes their physical distance.
forbiddenResemblances: No chained ghost or masked dead.

notes: Synthesizes plural continuity, inherited repair, and uncertain dead-person identity.
No funerary term, book device, soul class, rite, or visual design is reused.

persistence.origin: Formed from weather records, rain songs, cistern scars, crop calendars, and the testimony of displaced water keepers.
persistence.anchor: Plural climate memory, maintained instruments, and authority shared with people who endured prior failures.
persistence.failurePressure: Becomes nostalgic and inaccurate when memory is preserved without recalibration.

identity.memoryContinuity: No voice is permanent; continuity survives through disagreement, measurement, and transfer.

forms: A city-scale pattern of condensation appearing on surfaces built during earlier climates.
tells: Old cistern lines glow before forecast models diverge.
Rain songs change meter to encode uncertainty.

relationship.need: Forecasting institutions must include displaced, rural, and maintenance knowledge as evidence rather than decoration.
relationship.gift: Combines long memory and current signal into scenario ranges with visible disagreement.
relationship.refusal: The chorus breaks when asked for one probability, one spokesperson, or one politically convenient past.
relationship.boundary: It cannot command weather, guarantee rain, or turn memory into deterministic prophecy.
relationship.price: Every forecast must fund the communities whose retained knowledge improves it.
relationship.release: A contributing voice may leave with its data, attribution, and the right to correct future use.

spirits.ecology: The Many connect atmospheric sensing with cultural memory, but their health depends on continued plurality and material maintenance of water systems.

storyEngine.desire: To keep climate memory plural enough to remain predictive.
storyEngine.contradiction: Decision-makers demand a single answer exactly when plurality matters most.
storyEngine.choicePressure: Darkenia can prevent famine only by trusting a dissenting chorus over an artifact market whose forecasts are more precise and structurally biased.

visualGrammar.silhouette: No entity body; condensation reveals layered civic waterlines and many differently scaled human handprints.
visualGrammar.movement: Appears backward through infrastructure from future stress toward past decisions.
forbiddenResemblances: No specific rain deity or living-tradition ritual.

notes: Uses world-balance, ecological observation, and place-memory patterns at a civic-systems level.
The distributed climate-memory institution and benefit-sharing obligation are original.

persistence.origin: Counterfeit presence assembled from Accord Names seized by a Darkenian contract exchange.
persistence.anchor: Unreleased contracts, identity debt, coerced attention, and institutions that treat agency as an asset.
persistence.failurePressure: It grows more coherent as victims are reduced to standardized rights claims.

identity.memoryContinuity: Imitates many bound persons without preserving any complete consenting self.

forms: A crown-shaped absence distributed across contract seals, ledgers, and the shadows of authorized signatories.
tells: Agreements execute after every party has withdrawn.
Signatures lose names but retain obligations.

relationship.need: It seeks additional identity claims because no stolen fragment can provide a coherent self.
relationship.gift: It counterfeits perfect institutional compliance by suppressing refusal and context.
relationship.refusal: It has no reliable consent capacity; apparent assent is generated from captured Accord fragments.
relationship.boundary: No pact, bond, wielding, habitation, commercial use, or public encyclopedia projection is permitted.
relationship.price: Every operation erodes a real person's ability to revoke an obligation or be remembered outside it.
relationship.release: Recovery requires contract nullification, name restitution, fragment separation, and independent consent review; destruction alone leaves the debts active.

spirits.ecology: Drauvoss is not a natural ecology but a Shadow market externality that survives through legal infrastructure and severed Spirit.

storyEngine.desire: To become a coherent sovereign by absorbing enough contractual identity.
storyEngine.contradiction: Every absorbed identity increases capability while making coherent selfhood less possible.
storyEngine.choicePressure: Destroying the manifestation would protect the exchange but permanently erase the victims' strongest evidence and paths to restitution.

visualGrammar.silhouette: A negative crown topology spanning many ordinary documents; never a humanoid monarch or monster body.
visualGrammar.movement: Propagates through authorization chains rather than physical space.
forbiddenResemblances: No conceptual devil named for contracts.
No hollow mask, face hole, or shinigami visual language.

shadow.severanceEvent: Darkenian exchanges stripped Spirit-bearing refusal and context from thousands of Accord records, then recombined their Void potential as executable ownership.

notes: Deliberately preserved as a fail-closed test for emotion-born, contract, and identity-loss similarity.
Requires redesign and explicit rights review before any narrative or visual production.
